scripts.install:services: npm --prefix services/auth install && npm --prefix services/raw install && npm --prefix services/socketio install && npm --prefix services/graphql install && npm --prefix services/jsonrpc install && npm --prefix services/stomp install
scripts.dev:js: concurrently -n auth,raw,socketio,graphql,jsonrpc,stomp -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue,red "npm --prefix services/auth start" "npm --prefix services/raw start" "npm --prefix services/socketio start" "npm --prefix services/graphql start" "npm --prefix services/jsonrpc start" "npm --prefix services/stomp start"
scripts.check:js: for f in services/*/server.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up signalr reverb mqtt wamp
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n js,infra -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:js" "npm run dev:infra"
